title: Effects of radiation emitted by WCDMA mobile phones on electromagnetic hypersensitive subjects
authors: Kwon Min Kyung; Choi Joon Yul; Kim Sung Kean; Yoo Tae Keun; Kim Deok Won
integrity_status: Exact held PDF and native PMC companion identities matched; no numerical release or human scientific approval asserted
scope: Masked real-versus-sham WCDMA near-head provocation in selected adult volunteers with and without self-attributed sensitivity; acute symptoms, physiology and exposure belief.
limitations: Selected acute protocol, volunteer selection and exclusions limit generalization. Repeated symptom and belief responses are not independent participants. A nonsignificant contrast does not establish equivalence or diagnose the cause of symptoms. Scientific, numerical and human review remain pending.
citation: Kwon MK, Choi JY, Kim SK, Yoo TK, Kim DW. Effects of radiation emitted by WCDMA mobile phones on electromagnetic hypersensitive subjects. Environmental Health. 2012. DOI: 10.1186/1476-069X-11-69.

claims.text: The masked real-versus-sham comparison did not identify significant differences in the queried symptoms or autonomic measurements under the tested conditions.
claims.locator: Main PDF physical pages 4 to 6, analysis and results; Tables and exposure-belief figure

claims.text: Participants reporting sensitivity more often believed exposure was present during both real and sham sessions; that group difference did not demonstrate reliable discrimination of the signal.
claims.locator: Main PDF physical pages 5 to 7, exposure belief and Discussion
